subject: general
question:
Find the HCF of

(a - b) (a + 2b), (a² - b²) (a + 2b), (a + b) (a² - b²), where a > b> 0
solution:
**Given:**

(a - b) (a + 2b), (a2 - b2) (a + 2b), (a + b) (a2 - b2) for HCF

**Calculations:**

⇒ HCF of (a - b) (a + 2b),

 
 

 (a - b)
 (a - b) (a + 2b)
 
 

 (a + 2b)
 (a + 2b)
 
 

 
 1
 
 

 

⇒ HCF of (a2 - b2) (a + 2b), 

 
 

 (a - b)
 (a2 - b2) (a + 2b)
 
 

 (a + b)
 (a + b) (a + 2b)
 
 

 (a + 2b)
 (a + 2b)
 
 

 
 1
 
 

⇒ HCF of (a + b) (a2 - b2)

 
 

 (a + b)
 (a + b) (a2 - b2)
 
 

 (a + b)
 (a2 - b2)
 
 

 (a - b)
 (a - b)
 
 

 
 1
 
 

⇒ HCF of (a - b) (a + 2b) = (a - b) × (a + 2b)

⇒ HCF of (a2 - b2) (a + 2b) = (a - b) × (a + 2b) × (a + b)

⇒ HCF of (a + b) (a2 - b2) = (a + b) × (a + b) × (a - b)

⇒ HCF = (a - b)

**∴ HCF of the given equations is (a - b).**
